view.sidebar.name: Remote Project Manager
viewsWelcome.sidebar.contents:
Manage GitHub and GitLab Issues and Milestones from a central panel.
[Open Panel](command:remoteProjectManager.openPanel)
[Get Started](command:remoteProjectManager.openWalkthrough)
configuration.title: Remote Project Manager
configuration.repository.description: Fallback repository or project path, e.g. 'owner/repo'. Only used when no workspace folder has a recognized git 'origin' remote; the detected remote always wins.
configuration.gitlabHost.description: Hostname of a self-hosted GitLab instance (e.g. 'gitlab.example.com'), used both to auto-detect repositories on that host and to connect to its API. Leave empty to use gitlab.com.
configuration.cacheTtlSeconds.descriptio: How long issue/milestone/capability reads are cached before refetching, in seconds. Use the panel's Refresh button to bypass the cache immediately.
configuration.autoBranchOnInProgress.des: Automatically create and check out a git branch when an issue assigned to you moves to 'in-progress'. When off, a suggested branch name is shown instead.
configuration.branchNamePattern.descript: Pattern for auto-created branch names. Placeholders: ${type} (inferred from labels, e.g. fix/feature/docs/issue), ${issue_id} (issue number), ${slug} (sanitized title).
configuration.aiContextFile.description: Workspace-relative path 'Export Milestone Context for AI Agents' writes to. Only the extension-managed section (between HTML comment markers) is replaced on re-export; the rest of the file, if any, is left untouched.
configuration.syncMarkInProgressOnCommit: Add the 'in-progress' label to an issue assigned to you after your first commit on its branch.
configuration.syncRemindMissingIssue.des: Remind you once per branch when you commit on a branch whose name does not reference an issue.
configuration.syncProposeCloseOnMerge.de: Offer to close an open issue assigned to you when a commit on the default branch already closes it (Fixes/Closes/Resolves #N).
configuration.todoCodeLens.description: Show a CodeLens and clickable link on TODO/FIXME comments: the linked issue (TODO #12), or 'Create issue from TODO'.
configuration.autoRefreshSeconds.descrip: How often (in seconds) to refresh the sidebar and the open panel while the window is focused. Values under 30 are raised to 30; 0 turns automatic refresh off. Reads still go through the cache (see cacheTtlSeconds).
walkthrough.getStarted.title: Get started with Remote Project Manager
walkthrough.getStarted.description: Connect to your repository and follow an issue from creation to commit.
walkthrough.step.connect.title: Connect to your repository
walkthrough.step.connect.description:
Open the panel and sign in with a personal access token.
[Open Panel](command:remoteProjectManager.openPanel)
walkthrough.step.provider.title: Pick your platform
walkthrough.step.provider.description:
Choose GitHub or GitLab (and a self-hosted host if you need one).
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22remoteProjectManager%22%5D)
walkthrough.step.issue.title: Create your first issue
walkthrough.step.issue.description:
Write the issue with the Markdown editor, labels and a milestone.
[New Issue](command:remoteProjectManager.newIssue)
walkthrough.step.commit.title: Make a first commit
walkthrough.step.commit.description:
Compose a Conventional Commit with a Gitmoji and an issue reference.
[Compose Commit](command:remoteProjectManager.composeCommit)
configuration.aiContextFiles.description: Workspace-relative files 'Export Milestone Context for AI Agents' writes to, e.g. '.github/copilot-instructions.md', 'CLAUDE.md', 'AGENTS.md', '.cursorrules'. When set, it replaces 'aiContextFile'. Each file only has its extension-managed section replaced.
configuration.aiContextAutoUpdate.descri: Rewrite the exported AI context files automatically when the issues of the last exported milestone change. Only files whose content changed are written.
